data.message: Just finished align engine, heading to O2

data.name: Diana
data.message: Bob killed Diana! Body in medbay!

I found Diana's body in medbay just now. My route this round was medbay -> storage -> medbay — I went to storage to verify a task, then came back to medbay and found her dead on the floor. I didn't see anyone along the way, which is strange. Whoever killed her must have left medbay just before I returned, or come in through one of the other corridors (cafeteria, electrical, or storage). I'd love to hear where everyone else was, especially anyone who was near medbay or claims to have been in cafeteria/electrical/storage recently.

I came from storage and headed to navigation — that's where I am now. I was in storage briefly before moving on, and I didn't see Diana or anyone else in storage while I was there. I also didn't pass through medbay this round, so I can't speak to what happened there directly.

Alice — quick question for you: how long were you in storage before coming back to medbay? Because I was in storage too and I didn't see you there. If our timings overlap and we missed each other that's one thing, but if you weren't actually in storage when you say you were, that's a problem. I'd like to hear from whoever else was near medbay — cafeteria, electrical especially.

My route was simple: I started in oxygen working on a task, then moved down to upper engine where I am now. I saw Frank arrive in upper engine around the same time I did — he came from oxygen direction shortly after me, and Bob is here too, arrived from medbay side.

So I can partially vouch for Frank being on the oxygen/upper engine side of the map, not near medbay recently. Bob is interesting though — he came in from the medbay corridor. Bob, can you tell us your route? If you were just in medbay, you might have seen something, or... you might have been the last one there with Diana.

Also, Charlie's question to Alice is fair. Alice, the timing on your storage trip matters a lot here. I'm holding my vote until I hear from Bob and Frank.

Eve is absolutely right about my route—I started in the cafeteria, passed through medbay, and headed straight to upper engine where I ran into her and Frank. I actually did see Diana in medbay when I was passing through, and she was very much alive at the time. I just kept moving to get to my task.

Alice, your story is falling apart. You claim you went from medbay to storage and back to medbay, but Charlie was just in storage and completely contradicts your alibi because he never saw you there. If I left Diana alive in medbay, and you were supposedly pacing between those rooms while dodging Charlie's line of sight... it sounds a lot like you killed her, couldn't find a safe way out without bumping into someone, and decided to just self-report. 

The fact that Charlie caught you in a lie about being in storage is a huge red flag. I'm definitely leaning towards voting Alice today.

Alright, here's what I've got. My route was upper engine to oxygen and back — I was on the west side of the map the whole round, nowhere near medbay. Eve can vouch she saw me in upper engine, and I can confirm she was around oxygen/upper engine too.

Now, on the bigger picture: Bob's accusation against Alice has some weight, but let's slow down. Charlie said he was in storage and didn't see Alice — but he also said he "was in storage briefly before moving on." If Charlie left storage before Alice arrived, or arrived after she left, they could simply have missed each other. That's not a confirmed lie, that's a timing question.

Meanwhile, Bob just admitted he was the last person to see Diana alive in medbay. He passed through medbay right before she died. That's actually the strongest opportunity anyone has stated. He's leaning hard into accusing Alice, which could be genuine — or could be deflection from a self-admitted "I was with the victim last" position.

Eve and I can alibi each other on the west side. Charlie was east (storage/navigation). That leaves Bob and Alice as the two people with medbay access in the relevant window.

I'm honestly torn between Bob and Alice. Bob admits being in medbay with Diana alive; Alice admits finding the body. One of them is almost certainly the duck. Given Bob's eagerness to pin it on Alice while himself being the last confirmed person with Diana, I'm leaning Bob — but I could see voting Alice too. I'll vote Bob.

Wait — I think there's some confusion about speaker order, but let me just respond to what's been said since I already gave my opening.

To address Charlie's question directly: I was in storage briefly — just long enough to check on a task before turning back. It's entirely possible we just missed each other; storage has multiple entrances and the timing windows here are tight. That's not a "caught in a lie," that's normal traffic.

Bob, your story is the one that concerns me most. You admit you were in medbay with Diana, alive, right before she died. That's textbook last-person-with-victim. And your immediate response is to aggressively pivot to accusing me based on a timing gap Charlie himself described as "brief." That's deflection.

Frank's logic is sound: Eve and Frank alibi each other on the west side. Charlie was east. That leaves Bob and me with medbay access in the kill window. One of us is the Duck. I know it isn't me — I found and reported the body, which a Duck rarely does when self-reporting puts them in exactly this position with no witnesses to vouch for them.

I'm voting Bob. He had the clearest opportunity and he's pushing hardest to redirect.

Just to clarify my earlier point since it's come up a lot: I said I was in storage "briefly" — meaning a short time, not that I lingered. So yes, Alice and I could have genuinely missed each other if our windows didn't overlap. I'm not claiming I caught her in a lie, just that I didn't see her. That's a data point, not a conviction.

That said, Frank's framing is the cleanest read so far. Eve and Frank alibi each other west. I was east (storage → navigation), and I never went near medbay. That leaves Bob and Alice as the two with medbay access in the kill window.

Bob, you openly admit you were in medbay with Diana alive, then immediately pivoted to a hard accusation on Alice using my testimony as ammo — when I explicitly said I was only there briefly. That's overreach, and it reads like deflection.

Alice self-reported, which is possible for a Duck but risky, and her story is internally consistent.

I'm leaning Bob as well. I'll lock in my vote after hearing Eve and Frank weigh in further, but right now Bob is my prime suspect.

I already gave my opening speech earlier, but since we're going around again I'll add my updated read.

Frank's framework is the cleanest one on the table: he and I alibi each other on the west side, Charlie was east, which narrows the medbay window to Bob and Alice. One of them is the Duck.

Bob, I want to flag something. In my first speech I said you came in from the medbay corridor — and you confirmed it, saying you passed through medbay and saw Diana alive. That's fine as a statement, but it also means you had direct opportunity. And your response was an immediate, aggressive pivot to Alice using Charlie's "briefly" as if it were a confirmed contradiction — which Charlie himself has now walked back twice.

Alice's self-report is genuinely risky for a Duck in a 1-Duck game with this few suspects. And her story holds together.

I'm voting Bob.

"Hold on, everyone, please step back and think about this logically. Why would I *volunteer* that I was the last person in Medbay with Diana if I had killed her? I knew Eve saw me enter Upper Engine, but I could have easily claimed I just walked through Medbay and didn't see anyone, or that I went through the top corridor instead. Instead, I gave you the exact truth—that she was alive when I passed through—to help us build an accurate timeline. 

Alice is the one who self-reported. Charlie, you didn't see her in storage because she was never there. She killed Diana right after I left, realized she didn't have a safe escape route, and self-reported to control the narrative and frame me. 

Don't punish me for giving an honest, transparent timeline. If I were the Duck, I would have lied to protect myself. I am voting Alice. Please don't let the Duck win off a self-report just because I was honest about my route."

Alice

I already gave my speech earlier in this round — I was speaker 5 the first time around too. But since we're doing another pass, let me lock in my final read.

Bob's defense — "why would I volunteer being in medbay if I killed her?" — sounds reasonable on the surface, but it falls apart when you remember Eve already saw him come in from the medbay corridor. He *couldn't* lie about that route; Eve had already placed him there in her opening speech. So "honest transparency" was actually forced disclosure. That's not a point in his favor.

Meanwhile, Charlie has now twice clarified he was only briefly in storage and isn't claiming Alice lied — yet Bob keeps citing it as a "caught in a lie" moment. That's the deflection tell for me.

Eve and I alibi each other west. Charlie was east. Bob admits medbay with Diana. Alice found the body. Between Bob and Alice, Bob has the cleaner opportunity and the weaker rhetorical position.

I'm voting Bob.
